definitions.explanation: The academic study of law — statutes, legal principles, court decisions, and their theory. Refers to the field as a discipline, not to law itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{法学|ほうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{法学|ほうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。

{法学|ほうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: Students who specialize in law aim to become lawyers in the future.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study, -ology). Refers to the academic field, not the body of laws themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法学|ほうがく}{部|ぶ}: faculty of law
- {法学|ほうがく}{者|しゃ}: legal scholar
- {法学|ほうがく}⟦{概論|がいろん}→概論：04126_gairon⟧: introduction to law
- {法学|ほうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: study law
- {法学|ほうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: major in law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧: law — refers to the actual body of laws, not the study of them
- {法律学|ほうりつがく}: jurisprudence — close synonym of {法学|ほうがく}; somewhat more formal
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: law — broadest term; covers both statutes and principles
